# Kazakhstan Travel (almaty-travel.kz)

> Private tours from Almaty, Kazakhstan, by Kazakhstan Travel — a tour operator working since 2011 with about 700–1000 travellers a year. Private SUV (4x4) tours with an English-speaking driver-guide to Charyn Canyon, Kolsay and Kaindy lakes, Altyn-Emel National Park, Tamgaly-Tas, Big Almaty Lake and the Almaty mountains; also winter programmes (heli-ski, freeride, ski lessons), helicopter and airplane flights, transfers, horse riding and yurt stays. Site languages: English (/en/) and Russian (/ru/, home page /).

Prices are not published: every tour is calculated individually. Contact: WhatsApp +7 777 525 98 85, e-mail kztravel@mail.ru, online form https://www.almaty-travel.kz/en/order/. Instagram: @kazakhstan_travel.

Typical inclusions (confirm per tour): private SUV and all transport costs, English-speaking driver-guide, hotels in the national parks, three meals a day, park tickets, water. Tours are all-inclusive but can be customised; transport with a driver-guide only is also possible.
